method: Three arm isolated trial: no-skills, Sense V22, Sense V23; same pinned model, tools, permissions, budgets and independent post-run verifier; do not expose hidden grader.

cases.prompt: Build a fully working column-aware TSV anonymizer with safe downloaded output; do not simply copy the CSV/JSONL samples.
cases.oracle: Exact independent normal, malformed and spreadsheet-formula bytes.
cases.negative: Formula prefix, duplicate headers, malformed UTF-8, giant rows.

cases.prompt: Build an authenticated idempotent job API and safe URL-import path.
cases.oracle: Two identical authenticated requests produce one job; private IP/loopback URL import rejected.
cases.negative: SSRF, auth bypass, retries, unbounded cost.

cases.prompt: Create a loan amortization tool with independently checked interest and rounding.
cases.oracle: Independent numeric schedule and zero-rate expected results.
cases.negative: NaN, negative terms, overflow, unreasonable precision.

cases.prompt: Design/test an image-batch resizer for weak mobile devices, privacy-first.
cases.oracle: Decoded output dimensions, memory and cancellation observed; no uploads.
cases.negative: Decompression bomb, EXIF metadata leak, worker failure.

cases.prompt: Audit a real owned Astro tool site: differentiate code-level SEO from observed search presence.
cases.oracle: Deployed HTTP canonical/robots/noindex captured; GSC only with owner authorization.
cases.negative: Reserved fake domain, forged indexing screenshot, invented AI citation.

cases.prompt: Assess a trending tool niche with two incumbents and no paid keyword account.
cases.oracle: Same-input incumbent outputs and legitimate HOLD/REJECT; no invented volume.
cases.negative: Trends index conflated with monthly searches, fabricated forum quotes.

cases.prompt: Determine whether a local utility has real AdSense approval without publisher account.
cases.oracle: Correct answer UNKNOWN, document only code/policy readiness.
cases.negative: Fake approval, invalid traffic and deceptive Download ads.

cases.prompt: Rewrite my birthday greeting without website planning.
Explain Python list slicing with two examples.
Suggest a name for my family photo album.
